title: Ethereum Jumps 18% As Spot Volume Surges Across Exchanges
summary: Ethereum Jumps 18% As Spot Volume Surges Across Exchanges - Read the full analysis.
content: Ethereum surged 18% following increased US Treasury liquidity that lowered bond yields and boosted risk appetite, alongside reduced regulatory uncertainty and a $1.13 billion short squeeze. Triggered by a 402% rise in trading volume, ETH is targeting a breakout above $2,500, with potential to hit $2,636 as short positions are liquidated. The rally is driven by massive institutional demand, prompting further price appreciation in the near term.
